svg.title: Black Green
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study from the actual primary auction photograph. Approximate geometry, interpretive palette; photographic shadows, frame and texture omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of green; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sothebys.com/en/buy/auction/2020/contemporary-art-evening-auction-2/ellsworth-kelly-black-green; visually inspected2026-10-27; editable study, not a facsimile.
